Source: Darkview_Phase1_Master_Plan_v2.pdf (§02 stop gate, §06 budget, §08 milestones, §11 task lists, §12 audit strategy, §14 definition of done) + Darkview_Build_Plan.pdf §14.

THE RULE ON EVERY INVOICE
scope annex → deliverable complete → acceptance act signed → invoice issued → bank transfer executed → evidence archived. Matching dates, never out of order.

DEFINITION OF DONE (all eight)
1 mission works repeatedly on real hardware · 2 every claimed expense evidenced and filed · 3 market-value pack exists · 4 accountant's written positions issued · 5 fifteen+ archived runs · 6 daytime demo rehearsed twice · 7 audit report issued unqualified · 8 grant application submitted.
